services.name: Lazy River Tubing
services.desc: Adult (ages 13+): $40 Child (ages 2-12): $35 Groups of 10 or more (ages 2+): $35 Tickets include: tube, life vest, shuttle to and from river, guides to accompany you, and a great experience on the beautiful Hudson river. 2 Hour Round Trip (includes 1+ hour on the water & bus ride to and from the river) About Lazy River Tubing with Tubby Tubes River Co is a great way to enjoy the Adirondacks with friends and family on the Lower Hudson River. Located only 5 minutes from Lake George NY. Tubby Tubes is the pioneer of lazy river tubing in the Lake George area.
